CONTACT_IMPORT_JOURNEY.TITLE: Import contacts
CONTACT_IMPORT_JOURNEY.SUBTITLE: Upload the spreadsheet. We find the columns, the companies and the extra information of each contact.
CONTACT_IMPORT_JOURNEY.REVIEW_SUBTITLE: Check before importing. Nothing goes into your contacts until you import.

UPLOAD.LABEL: Drop the spreadsheet here or click to choose
UPLOAD.HINT: CSV or Excel · up to {size} MB · name and mobile or e-mail; company and other columns are welcome
UPLOAD.ERROR: Could not send the spreadsheet. Try again.
UPLOAD.TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than {size} MB.

COLUMNS.TITLE: Columns found
COLUMNS.CHOOSE_TITLE: Tell us which column has each piece of information
COLUMNS.CHOOSE_HINT: We could not be sure about every column. Pick them below; mobile or e-mail is required.
COLUMNS.NEED_CONTACT: Choose the mobile or the e-mail column.

ATTRIBUTES.TITLE: Other columns
ATTRIBUTES.PROBLEMS: {count} value stays out because it does not fit the attribute; the rest of the row is imported | {count} values stay out because they do not fit the attribute; the rest of each row is imported
ATTRIBUTES.KEPT: {count} value kept: the contact already had it | {count} values kept: the contacts already had them
ATTRIBUTES.NONE: The spreadsheet has no other columns.

PEOPLE.PROBLEMS: row with problems | rows with problems
PEOPLE.LEFT_OUT: These rows stay out. Fix them and upload again whenever you want.
PEOPLE.MORE: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Download the file to see all of them.

COMPANIES.TITLE: Companies
COMPANIES.HINT: The {column} column has each contact's company.
COMPANIES.DISABLED: No company will be created or linked.

ERRORS.IMPORT_FAILED: The import stopped before the end. Contacts already saved stay saved.
ERRORS.FILE_REFUSED: This spreadsheet could not be used.

REASONS.no_valid_rows: No row has a valid mobile or e-mail
REASONS.row_limit_exceeded: The spreadsheet has more rows than allowed
REASONS.unsupported_file_format: Use a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file
REASONS.file_could_not_be_processed: The file could not be read
REASONS.missing_contact_column: Choose the mobile or the e-mail column
REASONS.invalid_column_choice: That column choice is not valid
